#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the 34 final SVGs against the locked assetManifest contract.

Checks per asset:
  (a) file exists at public/assets/<folder>/<key>.svg
  (b) well-formed XML (parsed with xml.etree.ElementTree, namespaced)
  (c) self-contained: no <image>, no external href/xlink:href, no url(file),
      no @font-face/external font, no http(s):// (data: and #frag refs are OK)
  (d) root <svg> viewBox == '0 0 <w> <h>' and width/height attrs consistent
Also: exact count == 34, no extra/missing keys, file sizes.
"""
import os
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = "/home/kfk/my/Dev/FF/Happy Dog Runner/.worktrees/196a2ab5-edb4-43a4-aa8e-a1c863c633ac"
MANIFEST_TS = os.path.join(ROOT, "src/config/assetManifest.ts")
PUBLIC = os.path.join(ROOT, "public/assets")

# ---- 1. Parse assetManifest.ts -> list of (key, w, h, folder) ----
src = open(MANIFEST_TS, encoding="utf-8").read()
pat = re.compile(r"asset\(\s*'([^']+)'\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*'([^']+)'\s*\)")
manifest = []
for m in pat.finditer(src):
    manifest.append((m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)), m.group(4)))

print(f"=== Parsed {len(manifest)} manifest entries from assetManifest.ts ===")
if len(manifest) != 34:
    print(f"!! manifest entry count = {len(manifest)} (expected 34) — TS parse problem?")
for k, w, h, f in manifest:
    print(f"  {f:9} {k:20} {w:>4}x{h:<4}")

# ---- 2. Inventory on-disk SVGs ----
disk = []
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(PUBLIC):
    for name in fn:
        if name.endswith(".svg"):
            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp, name), ROOT)
            disk.append(rel)
disk.sort()

manifest_paths = {f"public/assets/{f}/{k}.svg" for (k, w, h, f) in manifest}
disk_set = set(disk)
missing = sorted(manifest_paths - disk_set)
extra = sorted(disk_set - manifest_paths)

print(f"\n=== On-disk SVG count: {len(disk)} (expected 34) ===")
print(f"MISSING (in manifest, not on disk): {missing or 'none'}")
print(f"EXTRA   (on disk, not in manifest): {extra or 'none'}")

# ---- 3. Per-asset deep validation ----
def check_self_contained(text, rel):
    """Return list of (severity, issue) tuples. data: and #frag refs are OK."""
    issues = []
    low = text.lower()
    # <image> element (almost always an external raster ref)
    if "<image" in low:
        # try to report the snippet
        idx = low.find("<image")
        issues.append(("WARN", f"<image> element present: ...{text[idx:idx+120]}..."))
    # http(s):// absolute URLs (external)
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://", text):
        s = max(0, m.start() - 20)
        issues.append(("FAIL", f"absolute URL: ...{text[s:m.end()+40]}..."))
    # @font-face / external fonts
    if "@font-face" in low or "font-face" in low:
        issues.append(("FAIL", "@font-face / external font reference"))
    # xlink namespace usage
    if "xlink:" in low or "xmlns:xlink" in low:
        # xlink:href specifically is the concern
        if "xlink:href" in low:
            # inspect value
            for mm in re.finditer(r'xlink:href\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.I):
                v = mm.group(1)
                if v.startswith("#") or v.startswith("data:"):
                    continue
                issues.append(("FAIL", f'xlink:href="{v}" external'))
    # href= (generic) — allow #frag and data:
    for mm in re.finditer(r'\bhref\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.I):
        v = mm.group(1)

1	/**
2	 * assetManifest.ts — the SINGLE SHARED asset contract for the whole game.
3	 *
4	 * PreloadScene iterates this manifest to load every asset via `load.svg`, and
5	 * `scripts/gen-placeholders.mts` reads the same key/width/height set to emit the
6	 * Phase-1 greybox SVGs. Phase 2 REPLACES the SVG files against these EXACT keys
7	 * and dimensions — do not rename keys or change dims without updating both the
8	 * art and any code that positions the sprite.
9	 *
10	 * Conventions:
11	 *  - ALL graphics are SVG (locked override): one file per entity/state.
12	 *  - Keys are stable & namespaced (`dog_*`, `park_*`, `ui_*`, `vfx_*`, ...).
13	 *  - `path` is relative (no leading slash) so it resolves under any base path.
14	 *  - Dimensions are LOGICAL px at the 1280×720 landscape canvas; parallax /
15	 *    full-screen layers span the full 1280 width.
16	 */
17	
18	export interface AssetDef {
19	  /** Stable texture key used everywhere in code. */
20	  readonly key: string;
21	  /** Always 'svg' in this project. */
22	  readonly type: 'svg';
23	  /** Rasterization width passed to load.svg (logical px). */
24	  readonly width: number;
25	  /** Rasterization height passed to load.svg (logical px). */
26	  readonly height: number;
27	  /** Path under /public, relative to the document base. */
28	  readonly path: string;
29	}
30	
31	// Generic over the key so literal key types survive inference (powers `AssetKey`
32	// and the typo-safe `KEYS` lookup below).
33	const asset = <K extends string>(key: K, width: number, height: number, folder: string) => ({
34	  key,
35	  type: 'svg' as const,
36	  width,
37	  height,
38	  path: `assets/${folder}/${key}.svg`,
39	});
40	
41	export const ASSET_MANIFEST = [
42	  // ── Hero dog — 5 states + armored variant (spec §4.1). One MVP dog. ──
43	  asset('dog_run', 140, 150, 'dog'), // default auto-run loop
44	  asset('dog_jump', 140, 150, 'dog'), // on tap (rise + fall)
45	  asset('dog_hit', 140, 150, 'dog'), // on −1 HP
46	  asset('dog_victory', 160, 170, 'dog'), // victory screen / crossing finish
47	  asset('dog_defeat', 160, 170, 'dog'), // game over
48	  asset('dog_armored', 150, 160, 'dog'), // armored run overlay/variant
49	
50	  // ── Environment — park, parallax spans full 1280 width (spec §4.2) ──
51	  asset('park_bg_far', 1280, 720, 'env'), // far skyline/treeline (slowest)
52	  asset('park_bg_near', 1280, 360, 'env'), // near foliage (medium)
53	  asset('ground_tile', 256, 160, 'env'), // repeating ground/path tile (band y580→720)
54	  asset('park_fg_grass', 1280, 140, 'env'), // optional foreground grass tufts
55	
56	  // ── Gameplay entities (spec §4.3) ──
57	  asset('tick', 64, 64, 'entities'), // damaging enemy
58	  asset('tablet', 56, 56, 'entities'), // collectible (the product)
59	  asset('bush', 150, 110, 'entities'), // jump obstacle
60	  asset('puddle', 180, 50, 'entities'), // jump obstacle
61	  asset('armor_pickup', 64, 64, 'entities'), // shield power-up pickup
62	  asset('finish_line', 96, 480, 'entities'), // spawned once at LEVEL_LENGTH
63	
64	  // ── Armor VFX (spec §4.4) ──
65	  asset('vfx_armor_burst', 140, 140, 'vfx'), // pickup burst
66	  asset('vfx_armor_aura', 170, 170, 'vfx'), // persistent active aura (+ expiry flash)
67	
68	  // ── UI kit (spec §4.5 / §6) ──
69	  asset('ui_heart_full', 52, 52, 'ui'), // HP heart (filled) — shape+fill, not colour alone
70	  asset('ui_heart_empty', 52, 52, 'ui'), // HP heart (empty)
71	  asset('ui_score_icon', 44, 44, 'ui'), // optional score icon
72	  asset('ui_btn_pause', 64, 64, 'ui'), // HUD pause button
73	  asset('ui_btn_mute_on', 64, 64, 'ui'), // mute toggle — sound ON state
74	  asset('ui_btn_mute_off', 64, 64, 'ui'), // mute toggle — sound OFF state

77	  asset('ui_btn_play', 360, 104, 'ui'), // primary Play button
78	  asset('ui_promo_chip', 460, 120, 'ui'), // promo-code chip on results
79	  asset('ui_btn_cta', 380, 100, 'ui'), // buy CTA button
80	  asset('ui_btn_play_again', 300, 84, 'ui'), // secondary "play again" button
81	  asset('ui_pause_panel', 520, 360, 'ui'), // centered pause overlay panel
82	
83	  // ── Full-screen backgrounds (spec §4.5 / §6) ──
84	  asset('screen_bg_menu', 1280, 720, 'screens'), // main menu backdrop
85	  asset('screen_bg_victory', 1280, 720, 'screens'), // victory results backdrop

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the 34 final SVGs against the locked assetManifest contract.

Checks per asset:
  (a) file exists at public/assets/<folder>/<key>.svg
  (b) well-formed XML (parsed with xml.etree.ElementTree, namespaced)
  (c) self-contained: no <image>, no external href/xlink:href, no url(file),
      no @font-face/external font, no http(s):// (data: and #frag refs are OK)
  (d) root <svg> viewBox == '0 0 <w> <h>' and width/height attrs consistent
Also: exact count == 34, no extra/missing keys, file sizes.
"""
import os
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = "/home/kfk/my/Dev/FF/Happy Dog Runner/.worktrees/196a2ab5-edb4-43a4-aa8e-a1c863c633ac"
MANIFEST_TS = os.path.join(ROOT, "src/config/assetManifest.ts")
PUBLIC = os.path.join(ROOT, "public/assets")

# ---- 1. Parse assetManifest.ts -> list of (key, w, h, folder) ----
src = open(MANIFEST_TS, encoding="utf-8").read()
pat = re.compile(r"asset\(\s*'([^']+)'\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*'([^']+)'\s*\)")
manifest = []
for m in pat.finditer(src):
    manifest.append((m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)), m.group(4)))

print(f"=== Parsed {len(manifest)} manifest entries from assetManifest.ts ===")
if len(manifest) != 34:
    print(f"!! manifest entry count = {len(manifest)} (expected 34) — TS parse problem?")
for k, w, h, f in manifest:
    print(f"  {f:9} {k:20} {w:>4}x{h:<4}")

# ---- 2. Inventory on-disk SVGs ----
disk = []
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(PUBLIC):
    for name in fn:
        if name.endswith(".svg"):
            rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp, name), ROOT)
            disk.append(rel)
disk.sort()

manifest_paths = {f"public/assets/{f}/{k}.svg" for (k, w, h, f) in manifest}
disk_set = set(disk)
missing = sorted(manifest_paths - disk_set)
extra = sorted(disk_set - manifest_paths)

print(f"\n=== On-disk SVG count: {len(disk)} (expected 34) ===")
print(f"MISSING (in manifest, not on disk): {missing or 'none'}")
print(f"EXTRA   (on disk, not in manifest): {extra or 'none'}")

# ---- 3. Per-asset deep validation ----
def check_self_contained(text, rel):
    """Return list of (severity, issue) tuples. data: and #frag refs are OK."""
    issues = []
    low = text.lower()
    # <image> element (almost always an external raster ref)
    if "<image" in low:
        # try to report the snippet
        idx = low.find("<image")
        issues.append(("WARN", f"<image> element present: ...{text[idx:idx+120]}..."))
    # http(s):// absolute URLs (external)
    for m in re.finditer(r"https?://", text):
        s = max(0, m.start() - 20)
        issues.append(("FAIL", f"absolute URL: ...{text[s:m.end()+40]}..."))
    # @font-face / external fonts
    if "@font-face" in low or "font-face" in low:
        issues.append(("FAIL", "@font-face / external font reference"))
    # xlink namespace usage
    if "xlink:" in low or "xmlns:xlink" in low:
        # xlink:href specifically is the concern
        if "xlink:href" in low:
            # inspect value
            for mm in re.finditer(r'xlink:href\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.I):
                v = mm.group(1)
                if v.startswith("#") or v.startswith("data:"):
                    continue
                issues.append(("FAIL", f'xlink:href="{v}" external'))
    # href= (generic) — allow #frag and data:
    for mm in re.finditer(r'\bhref\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', text, re.I):
        v = mm.group(1)
        if v.startswith("#") or v.startswith("data:"):
            continue
        issues.append(("FAIL", f'href="{v}" external'))
    # url(...) — allow #frag and data:
    for mm in re.finditer(r'url\(([^)]*)\)', text, re.I):
        v = mm.group(1).strip().strip("'\"")
        if v.startswith("#") or v.startswith("data:"):
            continue
        issues.append(("FAIL", f"url({v}) external/resource ref"))
    return issues

results = []  # (rel, status, issues[], notes)
size_report = []

for (key, w, h, folder) in manifest:
    rel = f"public/assets/{folder}/{key}.svg"
    abspath = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
    issues = []
    notes = []
    if not os.path.exists(abspath):
        results.append((rel, "FAIL", [("FAIL", "file missing")], notes))
        continue
    size = os.path.getsize(abspath)
    size_report.append((rel, size))
    text = open(abspath, encoding="utf-8").read()
    # (b) well-formed XML
    try:
        tree = ET.fromstring(text)
    except ET.ParseError as e:
        results.append((rel, "FAIL", [("FAIL", f"XML parse error: {e}")], notes))
        continue
    issues.extend(check_self_contained(text, rel))
    # (d) root attrs: viewBox + width/height
    ns = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
    tag = tree.tag
    if tag != ns + "svg":
        issues.append(("FAIL", f"root element is <{tag.replace(ns,'')}> not <svg>"))
    vb = tree.get("viewBox")
    wa = tree.get("width")
    ha = tree.get("height")
    want_vb = f"0 0 {w} {h}"
    if vb is None:
        issues.append(("WARN", "no viewBox attribute on root <svg>"))
    elif vb != want_vb:
        # tolerate comma variant
        if vb.replace(",", " ") == want_vb:
            notes.append(f"viewBox uses commas: '{vb}' (== '{want_vb}')")
        else:
            issues.append(("FAIL", f"viewBox='{vb}' != expected '{want_vb}'"))
    # width/height attrs (optional in SVG, but if present must be consistent)
    def numish(x):
        return re.match(r"^-?\d+(\.\d+)?(px)?$", str(x)) is not None
    if wa is not None:
        if numish(wa) and abs(float(re.sub(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", wa)) - w) > 0.01:
            issues.append(("FAIL", f"width attr='{wa}' != {w}"))
    if ha is not None:
        if numish(ha) and abs(float(re.sub(r"[^0-9.\-]", "", ha)) - h) > 0.01:
            issues.append(("FAIL", f"height attr='{ha}' != {h}"))
    if wa is None and ha is None and vb is not None:
        notes.append("no explicit width/height attrs (relies on viewBox) — OK for load.svg")
    status = "PASS"
    if any(s == "FAIL" for (s, _) in issues):
        status = "FAIL"
    elif any(s == "WARN" for (s, _) in issues):
        status = "WARN"
    results.append((rel, status, issues, notes))

# ---- 4. Report ----
print("\n=== PER-ASSET RESULTS ===")
n_fail = n_warn = n_pass = 0
for rel, status, issues, notes in results:
    n_fail += status == "FAIL"
    n_warn += status == "WARN"
    n_pass += status == "PASS"
    flag = {"PASS": "OK ", "WARN": "WRN", "FAIL": "!! "}[status]
    print(f"{flag} {rel}")
    for s, msg in issues:
        print(f"      [{s}] {msg}")
    for nt in notes:
        print(f"      note: {nt}")

print(f"\nSummary: PASS={n_pass}  WARN={n_warn}  FAIL={n_fail}")

print("\n=== FILE SIZES (bytes) ===")
big = []
for rel, size in sorted(size_report, key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    marker = "  << >40KB" if size > 40960 else ""
    print(f"  {size:>7}  {rel}{marker}")
    if size > 40960:
        big.append((rel, size))
if big:
    print(f"\n  !! {len(big)} file(s) over 40KB")
else:
    print("\n  (no files over 40KB)")

print("\n=== SELF-CONTAINED RAW GREP AUDIT (transparency) ===")
# Aggregate counts of suspicious tokens across all files for a quick eyeball
import collections
toks = ["<image", "href=", "xlink:href", "url(", "@font-face", "http://", "https://", "data:", "xlink"]
agg = collections.defaultdict(list)
for (key, w, h, folder) in manifest:
    rel = f"public/assets/{folder}/{key}.svg"
    p = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        continue
    t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().lower()
    for tk in toks:
        c = t.count(tk)
        if c:
            agg[tk].append((rel, c))
for tk in toks:
    if agg[tk]:
        print(f"  '{tk}': {sum(c for _,c in agg[tk])} hits across {len(agg[tk])} files")
        for rel, c in agg[tk]:
            print(f"        {c}x  {rel}")
    else:
        print(f"  '{tk}': 0")

overall_fail = (len(missing) > 0 or len(extra) > 0 or len(disk) != 34 or n_fail > 0)
print(f"\n=== OVERALL: {'FAIL' if overall_fail else 'PASS'} ===")
sys.exit(1 if overall_fail else 0)
